#!/bin/bash

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../../../.." && pwd)"
TEACHER="${LOCAL_TEACHER_CKPT:-/home/mingyujung/private/seer/seer_node3/runs_lrnode_protocol_20260616/train/scratch/sd1_scratch_baseline_seer_scratch_baseline_v1_20260616_141040/33.pth}"
LATENTLOOP="${LOCAL_LATENTLOOP_ADAPTER:-/home/mingyujung/private/seer/seer_node3/runs_lrnode_protocol_20260616/train/distill_node/sd1_distill_node_lrnode_distill_from_scratch_baseline_ckpt33_lronly_v1_lw05_aw01_g4_20260620_202533/39.pth}"
CANONICAL_ROW="${CANONICAL_ROW:-${REPO_ROOT}/results/seer/latentloop/local_best91/local_best91_segment_grid_legacy_parity_20260731_v2/stage_a_ckpt33/ckpt33_L4_dense/segment_grid_row.json}"
DATASET_ROOT="${ROOT_DIR:-${REPO_ROOT}/architectures/seer/upstream/LIBERO_DATASETS/libero_10_converted}"
VIT_CHECKPOINT="${VIT_CHECKPOINT_PATH:-${REPO_ROOT}/architectures/seer/upstream/checkpoints/vit_mae/mae_pretrain_vit_base.pth}"
LIBERO_ROOT="${LIBERO_PATH:-/home/mingyujung/private/LIBERO}"
GPU_LIST="${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES:-4,5,6,7}"
OFFLINE_GPU="${OFFLINE_GPU:-${GPU_LIST%%,*}}"
CAMPAIGN_TAG="${CAMPAIGN_TAG:-q1q2_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)}"
CAMPAIGN="${CAMPAIGN_ROOT:-${REPO_ROOT}/results/seer/latentloop/comparison/${CAMPAIGN_TAG}}"
MASTER_PORT_BASE="${MASTER_PORT_BASE:-14200}"
RUN_K2_K8="${RUN_K2_K8:-1}"
VALIDATION_BATCHES="${VALIDATION_BATCHES:-120}"
CALIBRATION_BATCHES="${CALIBRATION_BATCHES:-60}"
RESUME_EVAL_FROM_SELECTED="${RESUME_EVAL_FROM_SELECTED:-0}"

LOCK_TOOL="${REPO_ROOT}/tools/seer/lock_latentloop_comparison_source.py"
ALIGN_TOOL="${REPO_ROOT}/tools/seer/audit_action_token_alignment.py"
OFFLINE_TOOL="${REPO_ROOT}/tools/seer/evaluate_latentloop_comparison_offline.py"
CALIBRATE_TOOL="${REPO_ROOT}/tools/seer/calibrate_latentloop_comparison_losses.py"
SELECT_TOOL="${REPO_ROOT}/tools/seer/select_latentloop_comparison_checkpoint.py"
PARITY_TOOL="${REPO_ROOT}/tools/seer/check_latentloop_comparison_k1_parity.py"
AGGREGATE_TOOL="${REPO_ROOT}/tools/seer/aggregate_latentloop_comparison.py"
DECISION_TOOL="${REPO_ROOT}/tools/seer/apply_seer_comparison_decisions.py"
ACTION_TRAIN="${SCRIPT_DIR}/train_action_correction_baseline.sh"
NONRECURRENT_TRAIN="${SCRIPT_DIR}/train_nonrecurrent_latent_baseline.sh"
EVAL_WRAPPER="${SCRIPT_DIR}/eval_latentloop_comparison.sh"

fail() {
    echo "[ERROR] $*" >&2
    exit 1
}

require_file() {
    [[ -f "$1" ]] || fail "missing file: $1"
}

require_json_true() {
    python - "$1" "$2" <<'PY'
import json
import sys

value = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8"))
for key in sys.argv[2].split("."):
    value = value[key]
assert bool(value), f"{sys.argv[2]} is not true in {sys.argv[1]}"
PY
}

if [[ "${RESUME_EVAL_FROM_SELECTED}" == "1" ]]; then
    RESUME_CONTRACT="${CAMPAIGN}/sequential_contract.env"
    require_file "${RESUME_CONTRACT}"
    mapfile -t LOCKED_DATASET_ROOTS < <(
        sed -n 's/^DATASET_ROOT=//p' "${RESUME_CONTRACT}"
    )
    [[ "${#LOCKED_DATASET_ROOTS[@]}" -eq 1 && -n "${LOCKED_DATASET_ROOTS[0]}" ]] \
        || fail "resume contract must contain exactly one non-empty DATASET_ROOT"
    if [[ -n "${ROOT_DIR:-}" && "${ROOT_DIR}" != "${LOCKED_DATASET_ROOTS[0]}" ]]; then
        echo "[RESUME] Ignoring ambient ROOT_DIR=${ROOT_DIR}" >&2
        echo "[RESUME] Using source-locked DATASET_ROOT=${LOCKED_DATASET_ROOTS[0]}" >&2
    fi
    DATASET_ROOT="${LOCKED_DATASET_ROOTS[0]}"
fi

for path in \
    "${TEACHER}" "${LATENTLOOP}" "${CANONICAL_ROW}" \
    "${VIT_CHECKPOINT}" "${LOCK_TOOL}" "${ALIGN_TOOL}" \
    "${OFFLINE_TOOL}" "${CALIBRATE_TOOL}" "${SELECT_TOOL}" \
    "${PARITY_TOOL}" "${AGGREGATE_TOOL}" "${DECISION_TOOL}" \
    "${ACTION_TRAIN}" "${NONRECURRENT_TRAIN}" "${EVAL_WRAPPER}"; do
    require_file "${path}"
done
[[ -d "${DATASET_ROOT}" ]] || fail "missing dataset root: ${DATASET_ROOT}"
[[ -d "${DATASET_ROOT}/libero_10_converted/episodes" ]] \
    || fail "invalid ROOT_DIR; expected ${DATASET_ROOT}/libero_10_converted/episodes"
[[ -f "${DATASET_ROOT}/libero_10_converted/meta_info.h5" ]] \
    || fail "invalid ROOT_DIR; expected ${DATASET_ROOT}/libero_10_converted/meta_info.h5"
[[ -d "${LIBERO_ROOT}" ]] || fail "missing LIBERO root: ${LIBERO_ROOT}"
[[ "${RUN_K2_K8}" == "0" || "${RUN_K2_K8}" == "1" ]] || fail "RUN_K2_K8 must be 0 or 1"
[[ "${RESUME_EVAL_FROM_SELECTED}" == "0" || "${RESUME_EVAL_FROM_SELECTED}" == "1" ]] \
    || fail "RESUME_EVAL_FROM_SELECTED must be 0 or 1"
[[ "${MASTER_PORT_BASE}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || fail "MASTER_PORT_BASE must be an integer"
(( MASTER_PORT_BASE >= 1024 && MASTER_PORT_BASE <= 65000 )) || fail "MASTER_PORT_BASE must be in [1024,65000]"
[[ "${VALIDATION_BATCHES}" == "120" ]] || fail "VALIDATION_BATCHES is source-locked to 120"
[[ "${CALIBRATION_BATCHES}" == "60" ]] || fail "CALIBRATION_BATCHES is source-locked to 60"
[[ "$(basename "${CONDA_PREFIX:-missing}")" == "seer_libero" ]] || fail "activate conda environment seer_libero first"
if [[ "${RESUME_EVAL_FROM_SELECTED}" == "1" ]]; then
    [[ -d "${CAMPAIGN}" ]] || fail "resume campaign does not exist: ${CAMPAIGN}"
    require_file "${CAMPAIGN}/sequential_run_failed.env"
else
    [[ ! -e "${CAMPAIGN}" ]] || fail "campaign output already exists: ${CAMPAIGN}"
fi

mkdir -p "${CAMPAIGN}"
exec > >(tee -a "${CAMPAIGN}/sequential_run.log") 2>&1
STARTED_AT="$(date --iso-8601=seconds)"
trap 'code=$?; printf "status=FAILED\nexit_code=%s\ntime=%s\n" "${code}" "$(date --iso-8601=seconds)" > "${CAMPAIGN}/sequential_run_failed.env"; exit "${code}"' ERR INT TERM

if [[ "${RESUME_EVAL_FROM_SELECTED}" == "0" ]]; then
cat > "${CAMPAIGN}/sequential_contract.env" <<EOF
PROTOCOL=seer_latentloop_q1_q2_sequential_v1
CAMPAIGN_TAG=${CAMPAIGN_TAG}
STARTED_AT=${STARTED_AT}
GPU_LIST=${GPU_LIST}
OFFLINE_GPU=${OFFLINE_GPU}
MASTER_PORT_BASE=${MASTER_PORT_BASE}
RUN_K2_K8=${RUN_K2_K8}
CALIBRATION_BATCHES=${CALIBRATION_BATCHES}
VALIDATION_BATCHES=${VALIDATION_BATCHES}
LOCAL_TEACHER=${TEACHER}
LOCAL_LATENTLOOP=${LATENTLOOP}
DATASET_ROOT=${DATASET_ROOT}
RENDERER=osmesa
HELDOUT_36_38_INCLUDED=0
EOF
fi

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${GPU_LIST}"
export LOCAL_TEACHER_CKPT="${TEACHER}"
export LOCAL_LATENTLOOP_ADAPTER="${LATENTLOOP}"
export CANONICAL_ROW
export ROOT_DIR="${DATASET_ROOT}"
export VIT_CHECKPOINT_PATH="${VIT_CHECKPOINT}"
export LIBERO_PATH="${LIBERO_ROOT}"
export LIBERO_GL_BACKEND=osmesa
export MUJOCO_GL=osmesa
export PYOPENGL_PLATFORM=osmesa
export LIBERO_GL_REQUIRE_ACTUAL=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export TORCH_FORCE_NO_WEIGHTS_ONLY_LOAD=1
export SAVE_VIDEO=0

if [[ "${RESUME_EVAL_FROM_SELECTED}" == "0" ]]; then
echo "[1/12] Source/evaluator lock"
python "${LOCK_TOOL}" \
    --repo-root "${REPO_ROOT}" \
    --output-dir "${CAMPAIGN}/source_lock" \
    --teacher "${TEACHER}" \
    --adapter "${LATENTLOOP}" \
    --canonical-row "${CANONICAL_ROW}" \
    --vit-checkpoint "${VIT_CHECKPOINT}" \
    --dataset-root "${DATASET_ROOT}"
LOCK="${CAMPAIGN}/source_lock/source_lock_manifest.json"
python - "${LOCK}" <<'PY'
import json
import sys

assert json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8"))["status"] == "PASS"
PY
[[ "$(wc -l < "${CAMPAIGN}/source_lock/canonical_episode_manifest.csv")" -eq 201 ]] \
    || fail "canonical manifest must contain header plus 200 episodes"

echo "[2/12] Action-token alignment"
python "${ALIGN_TOOL}" \
    --repo-root "${REPO_ROOT}" \
    --output "${CAMPAIGN}/action_token_alignment.json"
python - "${CAMPAIGN}/action_token_alignment.json" <<'PY'
import json
import sys

value = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8"))
assert value["status"] == "PASS"
assert value["verified_overlap_previous_to_current"] == [[1, 0], [2, 1]]
PY

mkdir -p "${CAMPAIGN}/offline/calibration"
echo "[3/12] Raw-loss calibration"
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${OFFLINE_GPU}" python "${OFFLINE_TOOL}" \
    --repo-root "${REPO_ROOT}" --source-lock "${LOCK}" \
    --teacher "${TEACHER}" --canonical-adapter "${LATENTLOOP}" \
    --mode action_correction \
    --dataset-root "${DATASET_ROOT}" --vit-checkpoint "${VIT_CHECKPOINT}" \
    --libero-path "${LIBERO_ROOT}" --device cuda:0 \
    --batch-size 16 --workers 1 --max-batches "${CALIBRATION_BATCHES}" \
    --output "${CAMPAIGN}/offline/calibration/action_raw.json"
python "${CALIBRATE_TOOL}" \
    --raw-metrics "${CAMPAIGN}/offline/calibration/action_raw.json" \
    --mode action_correction \
    --executed-contribution-ratio 0.5 \
    --regularization-contribution-ratio 0.01 \
    --output "${CAMPAIGN}/offline/calibration/action_weights.json"
require_json_true "${CAMPAIGN}/offline/calibration/action_weights.json" pass

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${OFFLINE_GPU}" python "${OFFLINE_TOOL}" \
    --repo-root "${REPO_ROOT}" --source-lock "${LOCK}" \
    --teacher "${TEACHER}" --canonical-adapter "${LATENTLOOP}" \
    --mode anchor_bridge \
    --dataset-root "${DATASET_ROOT}" --vit-checkpoint "${VIT_CHECKPOINT}" \
    --libero-path "${LIBERO_ROOT}" --device cuda:0 \
    --batch-size 16 --workers 1 --max-batches "${CALIBRATION_BATCHES}" \
    --output "${CAMPAIGN}/offline/calibration/nonrecurrent_raw.json"
python "${CALIBRATE_TOOL}" \
    --raw-metrics "${CAMPAIGN}/offline/calibration/nonrecurrent_raw.json" \
    --mode anchor_bridge \
    --output "${CAMPAIGN}/offline/calibration/nonrecurrent_weights.json"
require_json_true "${CAMPAIGN}/offline/calibration/nonrecurrent_weights.json" pass

echo "[4/12] Training smokes"
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${GPU_LIST}" \
NODE_NUM=4 \
STAGE=smoke RUN_TAG="${CAMPAIGN_TAG}_action_smoke" \
RUN_ROOT="${CAMPAIGN}/train/action_smoke" MASTER_PORT="$((MASTER_PORT_BASE + 0))" \
LATENTLOOP_ACTION_CALIBRATION_JSON="${CAMPAIGN}/offline/calibration/action_weights.json" \
bash "${ACTION_TRAIN}"
require_file "${CAMPAIGN}/train/action_smoke/training_wrapper_complete.txt"

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${GPU_LIST}" \
NODE_NUM=4 \
STAGE=smoke RUN_TAG="${CAMPAIGN_TAG}_nonrecurrent_smoke" \
RUN_ROOT="${CAMPAIGN}/train/nonrecurrent_smoke" MASTER_PORT="$((MASTER_PORT_BASE + 10))" \
LATENTLOOP_NONRECURRENT_CALIBRATION_JSON="${CAMPAIGN}/offline/calibration/nonrecurrent_weights.json" \
bash "${NONRECURRENT_TRAIN}"
require_file "${CAMPAIGN}/train/nonrecurrent_smoke/training_wrapper_complete.txt"

echo "[5/12] Full matched action-correction training"
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${GPU_LIST}" \
NODE_NUM=4 \
STAGE=full RUN_TAG="${CAMPAIGN_TAG}_action_full" \
RUN_ROOT="${CAMPAIGN}/train/action_full" MASTER_PORT="$((MASTER_PORT_BASE + 20))" \
LATENTLOOP_ACTION_CALIBRATION_JSON="${CAMPAIGN}/offline/calibration/action_weights.json" \
bash "${ACTION_TRAIN}"
require_file "${CAMPAIGN}/train/action_full/training_wrapper_complete.txt"

echo "[6/12] Full nonrecurrent latent training"
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${GPU_LIST}" \
NODE_NUM=4 \
STAGE=full RUN_TAG="${CAMPAIGN_TAG}_nonrecurrent_full" \
RUN_ROOT="${CAMPAIGN}/train/nonrecurrent_full" MASTER_PORT="$((MASTER_PORT_BASE + 30))" \
LATENTLOOP_NONRECURRENT_CALIBRATION_JSON="${CAMPAIGN}/offline/calibration/nonrecurrent_weights.json" \
bash "${NONRECURRENT_TRAIN}"
require_file "${CAMPAIGN}/train/nonrecurrent_full/training_wrapper_complete.txt"

validate_checkpoints() {
    local mode=$1
    local train_root=$2
    local output_root=$3
    local checkpoints=()
    mkdir -p "${output_root}"
    mapfile -t checkpoints < <(find "${train_root}/checkpoints" -name 'microstep_*.pth' -type f | sort)
    [[ ${#checkpoints[@]} -eq 40 ]] \
        || fail "expected 40 ${mode} checkpoints, found ${#checkpoints[@]}"
    local index=0
    for checkpoint in "${checkpoints[@]}"; do
        index=$((index + 1))
        local stem output
        stem="$(basename "${checkpoint}" .pth)"
        output="${output_root}/${stem}.json"
        echo "[validation ${mode}] ${index}/40 ${stem}"
        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${OFFLINE_GPU}" python "${OFFLINE_TOOL}" \
            --repo-root "${REPO_ROOT}" --source-lock "${LOCK}" \
            --teacher "${TEACHER}" --canonical-adapter "${LATENTLOOP}" \
            --adapter-checkpoint "${checkpoint}" --mode "${mode}" \
            --dataset-root "${DATASET_ROOT}" --vit-checkpoint "${VIT_CHECKPOINT}" \
            --libero-path "${LIBERO_ROOT}" --device cuda:0 \
            --batch-size 16 --workers 1 --max-batches "${VALIDATION_BATCHES}" \
            --output "${output}"
    done
}

echo "[7/12] Held-out validation and checkpoint selection"
validate_checkpoints action_correction \
    "${CAMPAIGN}/train/action_full" \
    "${CAMPAIGN}/offline/action_candidates"
validate_checkpoints anchor_bridge \
    "${CAMPAIGN}/train/nonrecurrent_full" \
    "${CAMPAIGN}/offline/nonrecurrent_candidates"

mapfile -t ACTION_JSON < <(find "${CAMPAIGN}/offline/action_candidates" -name 'microstep_*.json' -type f | sort)
mapfile -t NONRECURRENT_JSON < <(find "${CAMPAIGN}/offline/nonrecurrent_candidates" -name 'microstep_*.json' -type f | sort)
ACTION_ARGS=()
NONRECURRENT_ARGS=()
for path in "${ACTION_JSON[@]}"; do ACTION_ARGS+=(--input "${path}"); done
for path in "${NONRECURRENT_JSON[@]}"; do NONRECURRENT_ARGS+=(--input "${path}"); done
python "${SELECT_TOOL}" "${ACTION_ARGS[@]}" --mode action_correction \
    --output "${CAMPAIGN}/selection/action_selection.json"
python "${SELECT_TOOL}" "${NONRECURRENT_ARGS[@]}" --mode anchor_bridge \
    --output "${CAMPAIGN}/selection/nonrecurrent_selection.json"

else
    echo "[RESUME] Reusing completed source lock, training, validation, and selection"
    LOCK="${CAMPAIGN}/source_lock/source_lock_manifest.json"
    require_file "${LOCK}"
    require_json_true "${LOCK}" status
    require_file "${CAMPAIGN}/train/action_full/training_wrapper_complete.txt"
    require_file "${CAMPAIGN}/train/nonrecurrent_full/training_wrapper_complete.txt"
    require_file "${CAMPAIGN}/selection/action_selection.json"
    require_file "${CAMPAIGN}/selection/nonrecurrent_selection.json"
    export SOURCE_LOCK_OVERRIDE_DIR="${CAMPAIGN}/source_lock"
fi

ACTION_SELECTION="${CAMPAIGN}/selection/action_selection.json"
NONRECURRENT_SELECTION="${CAMPAIGN}/selection/nonrecurrent_selection.json"
read -r ACTION_CKPT NONRECURRENT_CKPT < <(
    python - "${ACTION_SELECTION}" "${NONRECURRENT_SELECTION}" <<'PY'
import json
import sys

print(
    json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8"))["selected_checkpoint"],
    json.load(open(sys.argv[2], encoding="utf-8"))["selected_checkpoint"],
)
PY
)
require_file "${ACTION_CKPT}"
require_file "${NONRECURRENT_CKPT}"

echo "[8/12] K1 full-path parity smoke"
PARITY="${CAMPAIGN}/eval/parity_smoke"
PARITY_COMPLETE=0
if [[ "${RESUME_EVAL_FROM_SELECTED}" == "1" \
    && -s "${PARITY}/evaluation_wrapper_complete.txt" \
    && -s "${PARITY}/k1_parity.json" ]]; then
    require_json_true "${PARITY}/k1_parity.json" pass
    PARITY_COMPLETE=1
    echo "[RESUME] Reusing completed K1 parity smoke"
elif [[ "${RESUME_EVAL_FROM_SELECTED}" == "1" && -e "${PARITY}" ]]; then
    PARITY_ARCHIVE="${CAMPAIGN}/eval/parity_smoke_failed_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
    [[ ! -e "${PARITY_ARCHIVE}" ]] || fail "parity archive already exists: ${PARITY_ARCHIVE}"
    mv "${PARITY}" "${PARITY_ARCHIVE}"
    echo "[RESUME] Preserved failed parity artifacts at ${PARITY_ARCHIVE}"
fi
if [[ "${PARITY_COMPLETE}" == "0" ]]; then
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${GPU_LIST}" \
    EPISODES_PER_TASK=4 NUM_TASKS=1 NODE_NUM=4 \
    STAGE=parity_smoke RUN_TAG="${CAMPAIGN_TAG}_parity" RESULT_ROOT="${PARITY}" \
    MASTER_PORT_BASE="$((MASTER_PORT_BASE + 100))" \
    ACTION_CORRECTION_CKPT="${ACTION_CKPT}" NONRECURRENT_CKPT="${NONRECURRENT_CKPT}" \
    ACTION_SELECTION_JSON="${ACTION_SELECTION}" NONRECURRENT_SELECTION_JSON="${NONRECURRENT_SELECTION}" \
    bash "${EVAL_WRAPPER}"
    python "${PARITY_TOOL}" \
        --baseline-root "${PARITY}/full_seer_k1" \
        --candidate "canonical=${PARITY}/canonical_loaded_k1" \
        --candidate "action=${PARITY}/action_loaded_k1" \
        --candidate "nonrecurrent=${PARITY}/nonrecurrent_loaded_k1" \
        --action-tolerance 1e-6 \
        --output "${PARITY}/k1_parity.json"
    require_json_true "${PARITY}/k1_parity.json" pass
fi

echo "[9/12] 100-episode screening"
SCREEN="${CAMPAIGN}/eval/screening_100"
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${GPU_LIST}" \
EPISODES_PER_TASK=10 NUM_TASKS=10 NODE_NUM=2 \
STAGE=screening RUN_TAG="${CAMPAIGN_TAG}_screening" RESULT_ROOT="${SCREEN}" \
MASTER_PORT_BASE="$((MASTER_PORT_BASE + 200))" \
ACTION_CORRECTION_CKPT="${ACTION_CKPT}" NONRECURRENT_CKPT="${NONRECURRENT_CKPT}" \
ACTION_SELECTION_JSON="${ACTION_SELECTION}" NONRECURRENT_SELECTION_JSON="${NONRECURRENT_SELECTION}" \
RESUME_EXISTING_ROWS="${RESUME_EVAL_FROM_SELECTED}" \
bash "${EVAL_WRAPPER}"
if [[ "${RESUME_EVAL_FROM_SELECTED}" == "1" \
    && -s "${SCREEN}/aggregate/comparison_summary.json" \
    && -s "${SCREEN}/aggregate/screening_gate.json" ]]; then
    echo "[RESUME] Reusing completed screening aggregate"
else
    if [[ -e "${SCREEN}/aggregate" ]]; then
        SCREEN_AGGREGATE_ARCHIVE="${SCREEN}/aggregate_failed_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
        mv "${SCREEN}/aggregate" "${SCREEN_AGGREGATE_ARCHIVE}"
        echo "[RESUME] Preserved incomplete screening aggregate at ${SCREEN_AGGREGATE_ARCHIVE}"
    fi
    python "${AGGREGATE_TOOL}" \
        --stage screening --source-lock "${SCREEN}/source_lock/source_lock_manifest.json" \
        --action-selection "${ACTION_SELECTION}" --nonrecurrent-selection "${NONRECURRENT_SELECTION}" \
        --row "full_seer_k1=${SCREEN}/full_seer_k1" \
        --row "canonical_latentloop_k4=${SCREEN}/canonical_latentloop_k4" \
        --row "matched_action_correction_k4=${SCREEN}/matched_action_correction_k4" \
        --row "nonrecurrent_latent_k4=${SCREEN}/nonrecurrent_latent_k4" \
        --row "no_observation_latentloop_k4=${SCREEN}/no_observation_latentloop_k4" \
        --row "predicted_horizon_replay_k4=${SCREEN}/predicted_horizon_replay_k4" \
        --output-dir "${SCREEN}/aggregate"
fi
SCREENING_GATE="${SCREEN}/aggregate/screening_gate.json"
read -r ACTION_CONFIRM NONRECURRENT_CONFIRM < <(
    python - "${SCREENING_GATE}" <<'PY'
import json
import sys

rows = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8"))["rows"]
print(
    int(rows["matched_action_correction_k4"]["proceed_to_confirmation"]),
    int(rows["nonrecurrent_latent_k4"]["proceed_to_confirmation"]),
)
PY
)

echo "[10/12] Source-gated 200-episode confirmation"
CONFIRM="${CAMPAIGN}/eval/confirmation_200"
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${GPU_LIST}" \
EPISODES_PER_TASK=20 NUM_TASKS=10 NODE_NUM=4 \
STAGE=confirmation RUN_TAG="${CAMPAIGN_TAG}_confirmation" RESULT_ROOT="${CONFIRM}" \
MASTER_PORT_BASE="$((MASTER_PORT_BASE + 300))" \
ACTION_CORRECTION_CKPT="${ACTION_CKPT}" NONRECURRENT_CKPT="${NONRECURRENT_CKPT}" \
ACTION_SELECTION_JSON="${ACTION_SELECTION}" NONRECURRENT_SELECTION_JSON="${NONRECURRENT_SELECTION}" \
SCREENING_GATE_JSON="${SCREENING_GATE}" \
RESUME_EXISTING_ROWS="${RESUME_EVAL_FROM_SELECTED}" \
bash "${EVAL_WRAPPER}"

CONFIRM_ROWS=(
    --row "full_seer_k1=${CONFIRM}/full_seer_k1"
    --row "canonical_latentloop_k4=${CONFIRM}/canonical_latentloop_k4"
    --row "no_observation_latentloop_k4=${CONFIRM}/no_observation_latentloop_k4"
    --row "predicted_horizon_replay_k4=${CONFIRM}/predicted_horizon_replay_k4"
)
if [[ "${ACTION_CONFIRM}" == "1" ]]; then
    CONFIRM_ROWS+=(--row "matched_action_correction_k4=${CONFIRM}/matched_action_correction_k4")
fi
if [[ "${NONRECURRENT_CONFIRM}" == "1" ]]; then
    CONFIRM_ROWS+=(--row "nonrecurrent_latent_k4=${CONFIRM}/nonrecurrent_latent_k4")
fi
if [[ "${RESUME_EVAL_FROM_SELECTED}" == "1" \
    && -s "${CONFIRM}/aggregate/comparison_summary.json" ]]; then
    echo "[RESUME] Reusing completed confirmation aggregate"
else
    if [[ -e "${CONFIRM}/aggregate" ]]; then
        CONFIRM_AGGREGATE_ARCHIVE="${CONFIRM}/aggregate_failed_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
        mv "${CONFIRM}/aggregate" "${CONFIRM_AGGREGATE_ARCHIVE}"
        echo "[RESUME] Preserved incomplete confirmation aggregate at ${CONFIRM_AGGREGATE_ARCHIVE}"
    fi
    python "${AGGREGATE_TOOL}" \
        --stage confirmation --source-lock "${CONFIRM}/source_lock/source_lock_manifest.json" \
        --action-selection "${ACTION_SELECTION}" --nonrecurrent-selection "${NONRECURRENT_SELECTION}" \
        "${CONFIRM_ROWS[@]}" --output-dir "${CONFIRM}/aggregate"
fi

if [[ -s "${CONFIRM}/aggregate/preliminary_k4_verdict.json" \
    && "${RESUME_EVAL_FROM_SELECTED}" == "1" ]]; then
    echo "[RESUME] Reusing preliminary K4 verdict"
elif [[ -s "${CONFIRM}/aggregate/decision_inputs.json" ]]; then
    python "${DECISION_TOOL}" \
        --repo-root "${REPO_ROOT}" \
        --inputs "${CONFIRM}/aggregate/decision_inputs.json" \
        --output "${CONFIRM}/aggregate/preliminary_k4_verdict.json"
fi

echo "[11/12] Optional K2/K8 diagnostic"
DIAGNOSTIC_STATUS=SKIPPED
if [[ "${RUN_K2_K8}" == "1" && "${ACTION_CONFIRM}" == "1" && "${NONRECURRENT_CONFIRM}" == "1" ]]; then
    DIAG="${CAMPAIGN}/eval/diagnostic_k2_k8"
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${GPU_LIST}" \
    EPISODES_PER_TASK=20 NUM_TASKS=10 NODE_NUM=4 \
    STAGE=diagnostic_k2_k8 RUN_TAG="${CAMPAIGN_TAG}_k2_k8" RESULT_ROOT="${DIAG}" \
    MASTER_PORT_BASE="$((MASTER_PORT_BASE + 400))" \
    ACTION_CORRECTION_CKPT="${ACTION_CKPT}" NONRECURRENT_CKPT="${NONRECURRENT_CKPT}" \
    ACTION_SELECTION_JSON="${ACTION_SELECTION}" NONRECURRENT_SELECTION_JSON="${NONRECURRENT_SELECTION}" \
    RESUME_EXISTING_ROWS="${RESUME_EVAL_FROM_SELECTED}" \
    bash "${EVAL_WRAPPER}"
    if [[ "${RESUME_EVAL_FROM_SELECTED}" == "1" \
        && -s "${DIAG}/aggregate/comparison_summary.json" \
        && -s "${DIAG}/aggregate/additional_evidence.json" ]]; then
        echo "[RESUME] Reusing completed K2/K8 aggregate"
    else
        if [[ -e "${DIAG}/aggregate" ]]; then
            DIAG_AGGREGATE_ARCHIVE="${DIAG}/aggregate_failed_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
            mv "${DIAG}/aggregate" "${DIAG_AGGREGATE_ARCHIVE}"
            echo "[RESUME] Preserved incomplete K2/K8 aggregate at ${DIAG_AGGREGATE_ARCHIVE}"
        fi
        python "${AGGREGATE_TOOL}" \
            --stage diagnostic --source-lock "${DIAG}/source_lock/source_lock_manifest.json" \
            --action-selection "${ACTION_SELECTION}" --nonrecurrent-selection "${NONRECURRENT_SELECTION}" \
            --primary-summary "${CONFIRM}/aggregate/comparison_summary.json" \
            --row "canonical_latentloop_k2=${DIAG}/canonical_latentloop_k2" \
            --row "matched_action_correction_k2=${DIAG}/matched_action_correction_k2" \
            --row "nonrecurrent_latent_k2=${DIAG}/nonrecurrent_latent_k2" \
            --row "canonical_latentloop_k8=${DIAG}/canonical_latentloop_k8" \
            --row "matched_action_correction_k8=${DIAG}/matched_action_correction_k8" \
            --row "nonrecurrent_latent_k8=${DIAG}/nonrecurrent_latent_k8" \
            --output-dir "${DIAG}/aggregate"
    fi
    if [[ -s "${CONFIRM}/aggregate/final_verdict_with_k2_k8.json" \
        && "${RESUME_EVAL_FROM_SELECTED}" == "1" ]]; then
        echo "[RESUME] Reusing final verdict with K2/K8"
    else
        python "${DECISION_TOOL}" \
            --repo-root "${REPO_ROOT}" \
            --inputs "${CONFIRM}/aggregate/decision_inputs.json" \
            --additional-evidence "${DIAG}/aggregate/additional_evidence.json" \
            --output "${CONFIRM}/aggregate/final_verdict_with_k2_k8.json"
    fi
    DIAGNOSTIC_STATUS=COMPLETE
fi

echo "[12/12] Final contract"
python - "${CAMPAIGN}/sequential_run_summary.json" <<PY
import json
import pathlib
import sys

output = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
output.write_text(json.dumps({
    "schema_version": 1,
    "protocol": "seer_latentloop_q1_q2_sequential_v1",
    "status": "COMPLETE",
    "campaign": "${CAMPAIGN}",
    "action_confirmation": bool(int("${ACTION_CONFIRM}")),
    "nonrecurrent_confirmation": bool(int("${NONRECURRENT_CONFIRM}")),
    "k2_k8_status": "${DIAGNOSTIC_STATUS}",
    "heldout_36_38_status": "DISABLED_BY_PREDECLARED_GUARD",
    "selected_action_checkpoint": "${ACTION_CKPT}",
    "selected_nonrecurrent_checkpoint": "${NONRECURRENT_CKPT}",
}, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
PY
date --iso-8601=seconds > "${CAMPAIGN}/sequential_run_complete.txt"
rm -f "${CAMPAIGN}/sequential_run_failed.env"
trap - ERR INT TERM
echo "[DONE] ${CAMPAIGN}"
echo "[DONE] ${CONFIRM}/aggregate/aggregate_report.md"
